senses.gloss: or לְבֵי (v. לָבָה) [to grow white; cmp.
units: Joel I, 7,] to be dried up, v. infra.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 11a:14">M. Kat. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>פום בדיתאי לַבְּאֵי כוורי</he> Ar. ed. Koh. the Pumbeditheans laid the fish dry (by changing the course of the water); [ed. as corrected in marginal note (v. also Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 300): <he>בפום בדיתא לְבָאֵי כוורי</he> at P. the fish were laid dry (the water failing through some obstruction in the channel); Var. in Ar. <he>בריתא לְבָאִי</he> (read <he>בד׳</he>) the B’ditha dried up].
